name: kimi-review-commit
goal:
You are the checker of the PA's (Claude's) work. Review these files, written today: special_teams.py, st_local.py, mcp_client.py, inspector.py, personnel.py and runners/timed_run.py (paths relative to the crew folder). Look for real defects: wrong behaviour, crashes on plausible input, security holes (anything that lets a model-driven member read, write or run what it should not), resource leaks, and places where the code contradicts its own docstring or comments. Not style.

Report each finding as one numbered item: file:line (for example inspector.py:120), severity (high / medium / low), what is wrong and the concrete input or situation that triggers it, and the offending code quoted exactly inside backticks. Quotes are checked word for word against what your tools returned, and every file:line is checked to exist - read before you cite. Findings you are unsure of go in a separate list marked (unverified). Do not pad: five real findings beat twenty weak ones. If a file looks clean, say so.
